name: transend-root
description: Root package for Transend build scripts

scripts.build:win:msi: cd ui && wails build -platform windows/amd64 && cd build/windows/msi && wix build product.wxs -o ../../../../builds/transend_setup.msi
scripts.check:release: powershell -Command "$files = @('builds/transend_win.exe', 'builds/transend_setup.msi', 'builds/transend_linux', 'builds/transend_cli_win.exe', 'builds/transend_cli_linux'); $missing = @(); foreach ($f in $files) { if (Test-Path $f) { Write-Host \"✓ Found: $f\" -ForegroundColor Green } else { $missing += $f; Write-Host \"✗ Missing: $f\" -ForegroundColor Red } }; if ($missing.Count -gt 0) { Write-Host \"`n✗ Missing $($missing.Count) file(s)!\" -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 } else { Write-Host \"`n✓ All build files are present!\" -ForegroundColor Green }"
